lines.text: τὴν ιαην ἰνδικτιῶνα ἦλθον μετὰ τοῦ δικαίου (?) κατὰ μῆνα
lines.en: the 11th indiction I came with the dikaios (?) in the month

lines.text: αὐγ(οῦστον) εἰς τὴν Κωνσταντίνου πόλιν ὡς ἔθος (?) ... Ἐξῆλ-
lines.en: of August to Constantinople as is the custom (?) ... I de-

lines.text: θον σὺν θεῷ Ῥόδου ἰουλίῳ ςʹ ἔτους ͵ςωπγʹ (1372 p. C.) ἤτοι
lines.en: parted with God from Rhodes on July 6 of the year 6883 (1372 A.D.) or

lines.text: περσικοῦ ἔτους ψμδου μέχερ κςη καὶ παρώδευσε ♒ α μʹ μεʹʹ ...
lines.en: of the Persian year 744 Mecher 26 and it passed through Aquarius 1° 40' 45'' ...

summary.headline: Dated Travel Note and Aquarius Position
summary.text: A dated autobiographical note records travel to Constantinople in the 11th indiction and departure from Rhodes on July 6, 1372, with Persian-calendar dating and a position at Aquarius 1°40′45″; Martini is cited.
